caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional metal box with intricate detailing, shown from three different perspectives: an angled front-side view, a top view, and a side view. The box is primarily dark gray with patches of tan, rust, and light brown, giving it a mottled appearance. In the angled front-side view on the left, the box sits on four rounded feet. The front panel features an embossed figure standing next to a circular medallion displaying a yellow eye, and above the figure, there is a rectangular area with the raised text "THE BANK OF INDUSTRY." Another circular area at the bottom contains smaller, less distinct details. The sides of the box exhibit cut-out or raised leaf and branch patterns. The top view, shown in the upper right, presents a square panel with raised mechanical tools, gears, and hardware shapes arranged next to each other, and a small dish-like shape at the edge. The side view, at the bottom right, shows the surface covered in a prominent leaf and branch motif similar to the sides seen in the angled view. The background of the drawing is a plain, uncolored (cream or beige) surface, with the artist's signature "W.G. Fletcher" appearing in the lower right corner.
title: Bank of Industry
